name: Luciole
source:
A mechanic at the Revue moving amusement park.
Unless he's working he shuts himself away.
He doesn't have confidence in himself and is always saying negative things.
Because of some incident in his past he's escaping from reality and wants to live in a dream world.
He's against the protagonist getting her magic back and being released from the Revue.

Hobby: Sleeping
